title: Anima: black-and-gold female template
summary: Anima, unofficially nicknamed Inanna, is the author's personal mascot and female-character T-pose template. Black-and-gold outfit, front and back views. Not a character in story canon.
usage: Author-designated gold standard for future female-character T-poses and overall body proportions. Adapt height, body mass, and individual shapes to each character's established design.
